description: AI Architecture Decision Record — Write an Architecture Decision Record (MADR format): decision= (required) plus optional context=, options= (separated by |), number= and status= (proposed/accepted/rejected/deprecated/superseded). Returns title, context, decision drivers, options with pros and cons, chosen option (always one of the options), rationale, positive and negative consequences, risks with mitigations, follow-up tasks, a revisit trigger, and ready-to-commit markdown. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
